svg.title: Velo, a 2D motorbike physics game
svg.desc: Velo: a 2D motorbike physics game in the spirit of Elasto Mania. Written in TypeScript with a deterministic fixed-step simulation, so every leaderboard time is re-simulated on the server from the recorded inputs. The rider shown is a real replay of level 27, Lintel.

g.text: Ride the cave. Mind your head.
TypeScript · 512 Hz fixed step · zero physics deps

text.tspan: Every leaderboard time is re-simulated on the server
from the inputs alone, bit-identical across JS engines.

g.text: real replay · level 27 — Lintel · re-simulated from recorded inputs
